label: dormwarsfiverin1
title_zh: 自上一次之后的第一次

lines.en: label dormwarsfiverin1:
scene nightsky
Io and I manage to make our way back out of the tunnel without getting lost or encountering any other suspicious cliffs that lead to perpetual darkness.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 总算从隧道里走了出来，既没迷路，也没撞上别的通向永恒黑暗的可疑悬崖。

lines.en: She wants to stay together. And I do too.
lines.zh: 她想继续待在一起。我也想。

lines.en: Was it the most conventional “date” I’ve been on? Obviously not. But it fit her well and, by extension, I guess that means it fit {i}me{/i} well too.
lines.zh: 这是我经历过最正统的「约会」吗？显然不是。但它很适合她，推而广之，我想也就意味着它也很适合{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: There’s somewhere else I need to be, though. With {i}someone{/i} else who’s been nothing short of a pillar of my unfortunate existence for as long as I’ve been here.
lines.zh: 不过我还需要去另一个地方。去见{i}另一个人{/i}——自从我来到这里，她一直都是我这不幸人生中一根不折不扣的支柱。

lines.en: That pillar is on the precipice of crumbling now, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，那根支柱如今正处在崩塌的边缘。

lines.en: And it’s one that I imagine will {i}have{/i} to come up today if we’re ever going to keep it from collapsing.
lines.zh: 而我想，如果我们还想阻止它彻底垮掉，今天{i}必须{/i}把这件事摊开来说。

lines.en: I just wonder how the conversation is going to go. And I wonder how much of it is {i}real{/i} and not just one more impulse on an ever growing list of things that she regrets.
lines.zh: 我只是好奇这场对话会怎么展开。也好奇其中到底有多少是{i}真的{/i}，而不是她那份越来越长的后悔清单上又多出的一时冲动。

lines.en: scene black
Io and I say our goodbyes outside of the cafe and she leaves to go meet back up with Uta.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 在咖啡馆门外道别，她动身去找 Uta 汇合。

lines.en: She wants to kiss me again, but I deny her — not wanting to be spotted by my second date, who’s likely watching us from the other side of the window.
lines.zh: 她还想再吻我一次，但我拒绝了——不想被我的第二场约会对象撞见，她大概正从橱窗的另一边看着我们。

lines.en: I am sure this will not have any negative effect on Io’s already lackluster self-esteem whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这绝不会对 Io 本就寡淡的自尊心造成任何负面影响。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah1
: Greetings, sir! Welcome to Koi Cafe! Will you be dining in or taking your order to go?
lines.zh: : 您好，先生！欢迎光临 Koi Cafe！请问是在店内用餐还是外带呢？

lines.en: : Excellent! Just so you know, our special for today is “whatever I want to make you.” May I mark you down for one or two?
lines.zh: : 太好了！先跟您说一声，我们今天的特供是「我想对您做什么就做什么」。给您记一份还是两份？

lines.en: : And will you be having that hot or iced?
lines.zh: : 请问您要热的还是冰的？

lines.en: : Got it! Please wait one moment while I get everything ready for you.
lines.zh: : 好的！请稍等片刻，我这就为您准备。

lines.en: : You can go ahead and take a seat if you like. I can promise that if I {i}do{/i} use poison, which I will not confirm or deny, it will not be a lethal dose.
lines.zh: : 您可以先找个位子坐下。我可以保证，就算我{i}真的{/i}下毒——这点我不予证实也不予否认——也绝不会是致死剂量。

lines.en: : What happened to you?
lines.zh: : 你怎么变成这样了？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah2
: Hm? Whatever do you mean, cherished customer?
lines.zh: : 嗯？您这话是什么意思，尊敬的顾客？

lines.en: : I mean you were blonde less than 24 hours ago. And now you’re-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，不到二十四小时前你还是金发。而现在你——

lines.en: : Beautiful? Cute? Awesome?
lines.zh: : 美若天仙？可爱？帅气？

lines.en: : Normal.
lines.zh: : 正常了。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah3
: Normal?! I thought I looked pretty good as a blonde!
lines.zh: : 正常？！我觉得我染金发的时候挺好看的啊！

lines.en: : You did. You always do. Just {i}this{/i} is how I’m used to seeing you, so it’s the established baseline of what “normal” means to me.
lines.zh: : 好看。你一直都好看。只是{i}这个样子{/i}才是我习惯看到你的样子，所以它是我心里「正常」的既定基准。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah4
: Well, that’s good. Because I did it for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那挺好的。因为我是为了你才弄的。

lines.en: : No you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 你才不是。

lines.en: : No, I really did. The appointment I was talking about last night was for my hair.
lines.zh: : 不，我真的是。我昨晚说的那个预约，就是去做头发的。

lines.en: : But you don’t-
lines.zh: : 可你又不用——

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah5
: I know I don’t {i}have{/i} to do anything and that the color of my hair has virtually no bearing whatsoever on our relationship. {i}But,{/i} and hear me out here-
lines.zh: : 我知道我{i}不必{/i}做任何事，也知道我头发的颜色对我们的关系基本毫无影响。{i}但是，{/i}你先听我说完——

lines.en: : I think I am tired of changing so much. And I think I am finally ready to commit to one thing for good. And that thing, you may ask?
lines.zh: : 我想我已经厌倦了不停地改变。我想我终于准备好彻底定下来做一件事了。而那件事，你也许要问了？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah6
: Being {i}your{/i} homie! Which means returning to my homie roots with homie hair! And {i}you{/i} get to be the first one to witness this transformation!
lines.zh: : 就是当{i}你的{/i}哥们！也就是说，我要配上一头哥们发型，回到我的哥们本色！而{i}你{/i}是第一个见证这场蜕变的人！

lines.en: : Besides Haruka since she is also working right now and I needed her help clocking in earlier.
lines.zh: : 除 Haruka 之外——她现在也在上班，而且我刚才打卡还得靠她帮忙。

lines.en: : So, you’re...dedicating yourself to being my friend? And this has nothing to do with your newfound desire to want me to-
lines.zh: : 所以，你是……下定决心要当我的朋友？这跟你新近冒出来的、想让我——的念头一点关系都没有？

lines.en: : Don’t say it.
lines.zh: : 别说出来。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
: Don’t do it, Sensei. I know what’s coming.
lines.zh: : 别这样，Sensei。我知道你要说什么。

lines.en: : {i}Pound you with the intensity of a western silverback.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用西部大猩猩那股狠劲狠狠干你。{/i}

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah7
: Can homies not do things like that together?
lines.zh: : 哥们之间就不能一起做这种事吗？

lines.en: : They can, I think. They just don’t normally find out about it from their homie’s mother.
lines.zh: : 我觉得能吧。只不过一般不是从哥们的妈妈嘴里听说的。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah8
: To be fair — you {i}would{/i} have found out about it from me if you actually kept your phone on you. And {i}I’d{/i} probably be pregnant right now.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话——要是你身上真带着手机，这事儿你{i}本来{/i}会是从我这儿知道的。而且{i}我{/i}现在大概都已经怀孕了。

lines.en: : So you’re just gonna...roll with it? Not get all embarrassed and weird like you do any time you’re talking to someone else you have a crush on?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……这么顺着来了？不会像你跟其他暗恋对象说话时那样，浑身不自在、怪怪的？

lines.en: : I gain flirty super powers when I’m behind this counter. It’s a barista thing. Earns me more tips. Anyway, yeah. That is a thing that happened. {i}But...{/i}
lines.zh: : 一站到这个吧台后面，我就会获得调情超能力。这是咖啡师的职业病。能让我多拿小费。总之，是啊。那件事确实发生了。{i}不过……{/i}

lines.en: : But?
lines.zh: : 不过？

lines.en: : I was {i}very{/i} horny that night. Destructively so. And you know better than most that it is hard to act rationally under such circumstances. Which is why I have a proposal.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上我{i}非常{/i}饥渴。饥渴到具有破坏性。而你比大多数人都清楚，在这种状态下很难保持理智。所以我要提个建议。

lines.en: : I’m listening.
lines.zh: : 我听着呢。

lines.en: : Today, we will both go through this entire date wearing blindfolds. That way, the horny will not reach us.
lines.zh: : 今天，我们俩全程都蒙着眼睛约会。这样一来，色心就够不着我们了。

lines.en: : Proposal rejected.
lines.zh: : 提案驳回。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah9
: Shit. I guess we’ll just have to hang out like normal then and put the homiedom in jeopardy.
lines.zh: : 靠。那看来我们只能像平常一样待着，把哥们情谊置于险境了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s the whole point of a date, isn’t it? Shouldn’t you {i}want{/i} to be putting the homiedom in jeopardy right now so you can win the war?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那不就是约会的意义所在吗？你现在不该{i}巴不得{/i}把哥们情谊置于险境，好赢下这场战争吗？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah10
: War?
lines.zh: : 战争？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah11
: Oh! Right, that.
lines.zh: : 哦！对，那个。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我其实不太在乎。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah12
: I’m mostly just excited to hang out with you and I’m using the pretense of the date war as an excuse to do that since we haven’t just chilled in what feels like forever.
lines.zh: : 我主要就是很兴奋能跟你待在一起，而约会大战只是我拿来当借口的幌子，毕竟我们已经很久很久没有单纯地一起消磨时间了。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything special planned and don’t mind losing if you don’t wind up choosing me. I just want to spend time with you and make things feel normal again.
lines.zh: : 我没安排什么特别的，就算你最后没选我、我输了也无所谓。我只是想跟你待在一起，让一切重新变得正常。

lines.en: : You don’t mind, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不介意吧？

lines.en: : Not at all...I think I’d like that too, actually.
lines.zh: : 完全不介意……说实话，我觉得我也想要那样。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah13
: Cool! I’m gonna go say bye to Haruka and clock out then. She said it’s okay for me to bail whenever. She just wants to know when it happens so she can take over.
lines.zh: : 酷！那我去跟 Haruka 道个别然后打卡下班。她说了我想什么时候开溜都行。她只希望走的时候跟她说一声，好接手。

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I guess I’ll just...wait here then.
lines.zh: : 好，行。那我就……在这儿等你。

lines.en: : Mhm! Be back in a sec!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！马上回来！

lines.en: scene black
Rin disappears into the kitchen and returns with Haruka a minute or two later.
lines.zh: Rin 消失在厨房里，一两分钟后和 Haruka 一起回来了。

lines.en: Before I have a chance to greet her and feign an apology for stealing her employee, though, Rin races out from behind the counter and grabs my arm, pulling me to the door.
lines.zh: 不过我还没来得及跟她打招呼、假惺惺地为抢走她的员工道个歉，Rin 就从吧台后面冲了出来，一把抓住我的胳膊，把我往门口拖。

lines.en: : Away, homie! I will not let my work mom’s boobs deprive me of the opportunity for quality time!
lines.zh: : 撤，哥们！我绝不会让我工作上的妈妈的那对奶子，夺走我跟你共度美好时光的机会！

lines.en: : Our time together isn’t in jeopardy at all if we just stare at them {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 要是我们{i}一起{/i}盯着看，我们相处的时间可就一点都不受影响啊。

lines.en: : Ooh, good point. Haruka — could you jump up and down for us really quick?
lines.zh: : 哦，有道理。Haruka——你能不能为我们原地跳几下？

lines.en: : What? No. That’s completely objectifying and-
lines.zh: : 什么？不要。这完全是在物化我，而且——

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: Do it.
: Yes, [harukamaster].
lines.zh: : 好的，[harukamaster]。

lines.en: I use my powers for evil once more and Haruka has no choice but to obey.
lines.zh: 我再一次把力量用在邪道上，Haruka 别无选择，只能服从。

lines.en: : Woah. Look at ‘em go.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。看它们弹的。

lines.en: : I have too much power now. This isn’t fair.
lines.zh: : 我现在的权力太大了。这不公平。

lines.en: Rin and I only spend a good thirty seconds watching Haruka objectify herself before turning around and leaving her there to bounce on her own for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: 我和 Rin 只看了大约三十秒 Haruka 自我物化，就转身把她丢在那儿，让她自己永远弹下去。

lines.en: else:
: Rin, come on. That’s a married woman you’re talking to.
lines.zh: : Rin，别这样。你说话的对象可是个已婚女性。

lines.en: : But the boobs! You were on my team just a second ago! They must- aah!
lines.zh: : 可是那对奶子啊！你一秒钟前还站在我这边呢！它们一定——啊！

lines.en: I yank Rin by the arm to prove to her that I’m actually a good guy and that the fact that I’m sleeping with basically all of her classmates does not undermine my moral code.
lines.zh: 我一把拽住 Rin 的胳膊，好向她证明我其实是个好人，也证明我跟她几乎所有同学上过床这件事，并不会动摇我的道德准则。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah14
Then, before long, we’re right outside of the dorms. And everything feels somewhat normal again, just...
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们就到了宿舍门外。一切都重新有了几分正常的感觉，只是……

lines.en: That normalcy is now laced with the open admission that there {i}are{/i} more potent feelings present. Which is something I’ve always had to just assume until now.
lines.zh: 而这份正常里，如今掺进了一种公开的承认——{i}确实{/i}存在着更强烈的感情。而在此之前，这一点我一直只能靠猜。

lines.en: It’s not changing her, though. At least not in the ways it historically has. Which makes me unsure of whether or not this is some sort of bluff or...
lines.zh: 不过这并没有改变她。至少没有像以往那样改变她。这让我拿不准，这到底是某种虚张声势，还是……

lines.en: Maybe I {i}am{/i} special?
lines.zh: 也许我{i}真的{/i}很特别？

lines.en: Because she is to me, right? It’s not just her hair that’s making me nostalgic. It’s all of this.
lines.zh: 因为她对我来说也是特别的，对吧？让我怀念的不只是她的头发。而是这一切。

lines.en: The cafe banter. That feeling of the air going cold as the lights start to come on outside of the dorms.
lines.zh: 咖啡馆里的打趣。宿舍外的灯亮起来时，空气转凉的那种感觉。

lines.en: That infectious smile and the way her ponytail bounces when she walks.
lines.zh: 那个会传染的笑容，还有她走路时马尾一甩一甩的样子。

lines.en: The subtle glances I get of her ears and the subsequent realization that I’m always forgetting they’re pierced. So it’s like I’m {i}always{/i} learning something new about her.
lines.zh: 我不经意瞥见她的耳朵，随后才想起它们打了耳洞——我总是忘了这件事。所以就好像我{i}永远{/i}都在发现她的新东西。

lines.en: Even after all this time — she’s still not boring. She’s still Rin.
lines.zh: 即便过了这么久——她依然不无聊。她依然是 Rin。

lines.en: : Sooooo...
But that doesn’t mean she isn’t changing too. I’m just conditioned to believe that change always comes with negatives now.
lines.zh: 但这不代表她没有在改变。只是我已经被训练得相信，改变总是伴随着负面的东西。

lines.en: So this submission and {i}commitment,{/i} if that’s really what it is, puts me on edge and makes me want to grab ahold of her hair to stop it from bouncing and just...
lines.zh: 所以这种顺从和{i}托付{/i}——如果那真是它的本质的话——让我心神不宁，让我想一把抓住她的头发，别让它再晃，然后就……

lines.en: Keep her close to me.
lines.zh: 把她留在我身边。

lines.en: : You’re kinda...more quiet than normal.
lines.zh: : 你好像……比平时安静。

lines.en: : Is it the hair? Did I go a little overboard in trying to...go back?
lines.zh: : 是因为头发吗？我是不是想「回到过去」想得有点过了？

lines.en: : Why {i}do{/i} you want to go back, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你为什么{i}想要{/i}回到过去，Rin？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah15
: Hm?
: Are you not happy with the way things have been going? Do you think settling on me is going to make them somehow {i}better?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你对现在的状况不满意吗？你觉得选定我就能让一切变得{i}更好{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.

lines.zh: : ……为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re the only one I feel like I can be myself with.
lines.zh: : 因为只有在你面前，我才觉得自己能做自己。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah16
: No one else even knows I’ve changed my hair color back yet.
lines.zh: : 到现在为止，还没有别人知道我把发色染回来了。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that’s probably going to make Chika a little sad, but...I realized something yesterday. And I realized it {i}because{/i} of her.
lines.zh: : 我猜这大概会让 Chika 有点难过，不过……我昨天想明白了一件事。而这件事，我{i}正是{/i}因为她才想明白的。

lines.en: : So like, she was in the D&D contest, right? And she didn’t know anything about D&D so, being her friend, she asked me to teach her. And I was like, hell yeah. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 就比如说，她参加了那个龙与地下城的比赛，对吧？而她对龙与地下城一窍不通，所以作为她的朋友，她让我教她。我当时就想，那还用说，来吧。

lines.en: : So I did. And it went...mostly well. But during the competition, when I was explaining stuff to her, she looked at me and she said “You’re cute.”
lines.zh: : 所以我就教了。过程……大体还算顺利。不过比赛的时候，我正给她讲解规则，她看着我说：「你好可爱。」

lines.en: : And I blushed. Obviously. I think I’ll always {i}kind of{/i} like her. But, when we got up from the table and went our separate ways, I felt...stupid.
lines.zh: : 然后我脸红了。显然。我想我大概会{i}一直有点{/i}喜欢她。可当我们从桌边站起来各走各的时候，我觉得……自己好蠢。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah17
: I spent {i}years{/i} hiding my nerdy side from Chika because I didn’t want her to think I was uncool.
lines.zh: : 我花了{i}好几年{/i}在 Chika 面前藏起自己宅的一面，因为我不想让她觉得我不酷。

lines.en: : But I never {i}had{/i} to do that. Chika’s one of the most accepting people I’ve ever met. And she’s never been anything but nice to me.
lines.zh: : 可我从来就{i}不必{/i}那样做。Chika 是我见过最能包容的人之一。而她对我从来都只有好。

lines.en: : I did it anyway, though. And I did that because, for some reason, I felt like I had to {i}be{/i} someone to be with her.
lines.zh: : 可我还是那么做了。而我那么做，是因为不知为什么，我觉得自己得{i}成为{/i}某个人，才配跟她在一起。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah18
: Same with Otoha. I was always thinking, “Oh my God, she’s so much cooler than me. I can’t show her who I really am.”
lines.zh: : 对 Otoha 也是一样。我总在想：「天哪，她比我酷太多了。我不能让她看到真正的我。」

lines.en: : Even super personal stuff like my cutting I couldn’t really talk about with her because it just felt...wrong.
lines.zh: : 连我自残这种极其私人的事，我也没法跟她开口，因为总觉得……不对劲。

lines.en: : But with you — none of that’s ever happened. I don’t feel like I need to change or {i}be{/i} anyone specific. I can just...be Rin.
lines.zh: : 可是跟你在一起——那些从来没发生过。我不觉得自己需要改变，或者{i}成为{/i}某个特定的样子。我可以就……当 Rin。

lines.en: : And I think maybe that’s okay now. Maybe I {i}should{/i} be Rin. And maybe you should be you and we should both just...be together.
lines.zh: : 而我现在觉得，也许这样也没关系。也许我{i}就该{/i}当 Rin。也许你该当你自己，然后我们俩就……在一起。

lines.en: : As friends...homies...something else...whatever.
lines.zh: : 当朋友……哥们……别的什么……随便啦。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah19
: I’m trying not to think about it since thinking has never really worked out in my favor.
lines.zh: : 我在尽量不去想这件事，反正动脑子从来都没给我带来过好结果。

lines.en: : Mature, right? Am I finally cool now? Do I finally sound like an adult?
lines.zh: : 很成熟吧？我终于变酷了吗？听起来终于像个大人了吗？

lines.en: : No. You still sound like a confused teenager.
lines.zh: : 没有。你听起来还是个困惑的青少年。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah20
: Damn. Thought I was finally onto something.
lines.zh: : 靠。我还以为自己总算摸到点门道了。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} a mature way to look at things, though. Especially by your standards.
lines.zh: : 不过这{i}确实{/i}是一种成熟的看法。尤其以你的标准而言。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah21
: Yeah?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 真的……

lines.en: : It’s just the person you’re aiming those feelings at that makes me question whether or not I should put any stake in this sudden character growth.
lines.zh: : 只是你把这份感情投向的那个人，让我怀疑自己该不该对这突如其来的性格成长抱什么期待。

lines.en: : Then be like me. Try not to think about it.
lines.zh: : 那就跟我一样。尽量别去想。

lines.en: scene black
: Lets just...do nothing and see what happens for once.
lines.zh: : 我们就……什么都不做，看看会怎样，就这一次。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah22
We’re back in her room, where so much has happened. And for the first time since the last time I held her blood in place, it feels like I’m {i}supposed{/i} to be here.
lines.zh: 我们回到了她的房间，那个发生过太多事的房间。而自从上一次我为她止血之后，这是我第一次觉得自己{i}本该{/i}在这里。

lines.en: I’m not a buffer now. Not someone for her to bounce her feelings for someone else off of to see how they’ll land. Just someone to sit with and...experience life with.
lines.zh: 我现在不是缓冲垫了。不是那个让她把对别人的感情弹到我身上、看看会落得怎样的人。只是一个可以并肩坐着……一起体验人生的人。

lines.en: How long will it stay that way, though?
lines.zh: 不过，这种状态又能维持多久呢？

lines.en: : See that spot right over there? Where the alarm clock is?
lines.zh: : 看到那边那个位置了吗？放闹钟的那个地方？

lines.en: : That’s where I was standing when I got into an argument with my mom about wanting to have sex with you.
lines.zh: : 那就是我跟我妈吵架时站的位置——吵的是我想跟你上床这件事。

lines.en: : Very cool, Rin.
lines.zh: : 真棒啊，Rin。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah23
: And that chair? That’s where I was sitting when I was thinking about having sex with you. And then sending texts about the sex I wanted to have with you to you.
lines.zh: : 那把椅子呢？那就是我坐着想跟你上床时坐的地方。然后我还把想跟你做的那些事发短信发给了你本人。

lines.en: : I’d show you where {i}I{/i} was when I found out about all of this, but we’d need to walk halfway across town in order to do that. And I don’t think your mom would appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 我也想带你去看看{i}我{/i}得知这一切时身在何处，不过那得横穿半个镇子才行。而且我想你妈妈大概不会喜欢。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah24
: I kinda figured she was going to tell you.
lines.zh: : 我大概猜到她会告诉你。

lines.en: : I’m...really sorry about that. I’m not trying to, like...blow up your spot or anything. I know the last thing you need is people being suspicious about...you know.
lines.zh: : 我……真的很抱歉。我不是想……揭你的底什么的。我知道你最不需要的就是别人对……你知道的，起疑心。

lines.en: : She’ll find out even worse eventually. Everyone will. It’s only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 她早晚还是会知道的，而且是以更糟的方式。所有人都会。只是时间问题。

lines.en: : Did she, like...like obviously she wouldn’t give you her blessing. But did she want you to like...{i}talk{/i} to me about it? Or...
lines.zh: : 她有没有……她显然不可能祝福我们。但她有没有让你……跟我{i}谈谈{/i}这件事？还是……

lines.en: : I believe I’m supposed to “let you down gently.”
lines.zh: : 我想，我的任务是「温柔地让你失望」。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah25
: And?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : And...what?
lines.zh: : 然后……什么？

lines.en: : Will you?
lines.zh: : 你会吗？

lines.en: : Let me down gently.
lines.zh: : 温柔地让我失望。

lines.en: : Let’s sit on the bed...
lines.zh: : 我们坐到床上去吧……

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah26
: Test failed.
lines.zh: : 测试失败。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Asking you to sit on the bed with me just seconds after talking about how I want to bone you was a test on whether or not you’re going to let me down at all. And you’re not.
lines.zh: : 在说完我多想跟你上床之后几秒钟就叫你陪我坐到床上，这是在测试你到底会不会让我失望。结果你不会。

lines.en: : You love me too much. You’d never hurt your homie.
lines.zh: : 你太爱我了。你绝不会伤你哥们的心。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: At least not nowadays. Not now that the guilt of having {i}already{/i} hurt your homie has eaten away at you.
lines.zh: : 至少现在不会。既然「{i}已经{/i}伤过哥们一次」的愧疚已经把你啃噬成这样。

lines.en: : You’ve had no problem letting {i}me{/i} down gently, though. Multiple times too.
lines.zh: : 不过你「温柔地让{i}我{/i}失望」倒是从来没有障碍。还不止一次。

lines.en: : Are you telling me you’ve wanted me this whole time? And that our entire friendship is built upon your desire to one day claim my boy-virginity?
lines.zh: : 你是在说，你从头到尾都想要我？而我们整个友谊，都建立在你有朝一日想夺走我这个哥们的童贞的欲望上？

lines.en: : Not {i}all{/i} of it. But I’d obviously be lying if I said I wasn’t frequently masturbating to you behind the scenes.
lines.zh: : 也不{i}全{/i}是。不过我要是说我背地里没经常对着你打飞机，那显然是撒谎。

lines.en: : That’s okay. It’s not as bad as me masturbating to you behind a curtain while you finger Sana.
lines.zh: : 没关系。那总比我在帘子后面对着你自慰、而你正用手弄 Sana 来得轻。

lines.en: : You should have joined in.
lines.zh: : 你应该加入的。

lines.en: : I prefer my Sensei fully conscious, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 我比较喜欢 Sensei 完全清醒的时候，非常感谢。

lines.en: : You really are comfortable with me, huh?
lines.zh: : 你跟我在一起是真的自在啊，嗯？

lines.en: : I’d be more comfortable if you’d let me crawl inside of your skin and live there.
lines.zh: : 要是你肯让我钻进你的皮里住下，我会更自在。

lines.en: : Okay. You might be {i}too{/i} comfortable with me when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 好吧。你这么一说，你跟我在一起可能{i}太{/i}自在了点。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah27
: Yeah. I guess my flirting could use a little work. Can’t exactly look up any nice pick-up lines without a phone, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊。看来我的调情还得练练。不过没有手机，我也确实没法上网查什么好听的搭讪台词。

lines.en: : Do you know when you’re getting it back?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么时候能拿回来吗？

lines.en: : Another month or two maybe? I just hope I don’t get the Uta treatment and have mine blocked from sending pictures and stuff.
lines.zh: : 也许再过一两个月？我只希望别落得跟 Uta 一样的下场——手机被禁掉发图片之类的功能。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t want to miss another opportunity to show my family a five minute highlight reel of my masturbation skills.
lines.zh: : 我可不想再错过一次给家人播放我自慰技术五分钟精华剪辑的机会。

lines.en: : I’d be willing to accept a live performance in lieu of a video, just FYI.
lines.zh: : 我倒是愿意接受现场表演来替代视频，仅供参考。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah28
: Are homies {i}really{/i} homies if they’re not masturbating in front of each other?
lines.zh: : 要是哥们之间不互相对着自慰，那还算{i}真的{/i}哥们吗？

lines.en: : I’m not doing anything like that. I’m just going to sit there and look cool while you go to town on yourself.
lines.zh: : 我可不做那种事。我就坐在那儿装酷，看你自己折腾。

lines.en: : Kinky. We should stop now, though. I’m starting to want you again.
lines.zh: : 真变态。不过我们该打住了。我又开始想要你了。

lines.en: : I thought that was a given now? And what better time than the present?
lines.zh: : 我以为现在这已经是板上钉钉的事了？而且还有比此时此刻更好的时机吗？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah29
: We both {i}obviously{/i} want this. We’re on a “date.” We’re alone in your room. There’s no reason {i}not{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 我们俩{i}显然{/i}都想要。我们在「约会」。我们单独在你的房间里。没有理由{i}不{/i}做。

lines.en: : You said it yourself just a little while ago. Let’s just see what happens. Why hold back at all?
lines.zh: : 你不久前自己说的。我们就看看会怎样。何必有所保留呢？

lines.en: : Sensei, just because I can be myself around you and {i}obviously{/i} want to do stuff with you doesn’t mean I {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei，我能在你面前做自己、而且{i}显然{/i}想跟你做那些事，不代表我{i}就该{/i}做。

lines.en: : I literally {i}just{/i} got lectured on how dumb I am for wanting you in the first place. {i}You{/i} think I’m dumb for wanting you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我{i}刚刚{/i}才被人教训了一顿，说我一开始想要你有多蠢。{i}你{/i}也觉得我一开始想要你很蠢。

lines.en: : That’s why this whole thing is a little confusing to me. You’re such an important person in my life and I don’t want to change that. I just {i}also{/i} really want to touch you.
lines.zh: : 所以整件事让我有点困惑。你是我生命中如此重要的人，我不想改变这一点。我只是{i}也{/i}真的很想碰你。

lines.en: : And I want you to touch me. Everywhere. Until I am sweaty and crying and convulsing from pleasures I have never felt before.
lines.zh: : 我也想让你碰我。碰遍每一处。直到我浑身是汗、哭出来、因从未体验过的快感而抽搐。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah30

: {size=-2}I want that {i}so much,{/i} in fact, that if you were to push me down and have your way with me right now, I would happily oblige and then probably have an orgasm within ten seconds.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}事实上，我{i}太想要{/i}了，以至于如果你现在把我按倒、对我为所欲为，我会欣然从命，然后大概十秒内就会高潮。{/size}

lines.en: : But don’t {i}you{/i} want something different?
lines.zh: : 可是{i}你{/i}不想要点不一样的吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah31
: Don’t {i}you{/i} think it’d be nice to have a relationship that doesn’t just flip a switch out of nowhere?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}不觉得，一段不是突然之间就拨动开关的感情会很美好吗？

lines.en: : One that {i}seems{/i} impulsive, but is really just the result of two people with undeniable feelings for one another opening themselves up over time?
lines.zh: : 一段{i}看起来{/i}像一时冲动，实际上却是两个对彼此怀着无可否认感情的人，在漫长时间里慢慢敞开自己的结果？

lines.en: : Because it’s easy to look at {i}us{/i} and think, “Oh — another high schooler with the hots for her teacher,” or “Another creepy, predatorial adult.”
lines.zh: : 因为人们很容易看着{i}我们{/i}就想：「哦——又一个对老师发春的女高中生」，或者「又一个恶心、居心不良的成年人」。

lines.en: : Hey.
: But if that happens over a long period of time, it’s no longer impulsive at all. It’s sweet and cute and-
lines.zh: : 可如果那是经过漫长时间发生的，那就根本不是一时冲动了。那是甜蜜又可爱的，而且——

lines.en: : Grooming. What you are referring to is “grooming.”
lines.zh: : 那是诱导。你说的那个词叫「诱导」。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah32
: Oh. Is that what that means?
lines.zh: : 哦。是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Rin. And none of it is good. In fact, what you’re suggesting is kind of {i}worse{/i} in a way because {i}all{/i} people are impulsive.
lines.zh: : 是的，Rin。而且那一切都不好。事实上，你提议的那种在某种意义上{i}更糟{/i}，因为{i}所有{/i}人都会一时冲动。

lines.en: : And not everyone can see someone as wonderful and special as you and slowly corrupt them over a long period of time.
lines.zh: : 而且不是谁都能看着像你这样美好、这样特别的人，然后在漫长时间里慢慢把她带坏。

lines.en: : Yeah. Good point.
lines.zh: : 嗯。有道理。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah33
: Guess we can skip all that buildup then and just cut to the part where our tongues are in each other’s mouths.
lines.zh: : 那我们干脆跳过所有铺垫，直接进入把舌头伸进对方嘴里的环节吧。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah34
: Why do you look scared? I’m me. And you’re you. Isn’t that enough?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一脸害怕？我就是我。你就是你。这还不够吗？

lines.en: if rinkiss == True:
: Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: : Because the last time this happened, you forgot about me.
lines.zh: : 因为上一次发生这种事的时候，你把我忘了。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah35
: And I don’t want that to happen a-
lines.zh: : 而我不想让那种事再——

lines.en: : I never {i}forgot{/i} about you. Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 我从来没有{i}忘{/i}过你。你是认真的吗？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah36
: There has not been a single day since then where you or {i}that moment{/i} has slipped by.
lines.zh: : 从那以后，没有哪一天你或者{i}那个瞬间{/i}从我脑海里溜走过。

lines.en: : If anything, I’d say it torments me even {i}more{/i} because {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s had to live with the guilt of depriving us both of something that could have been special.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，它反而折磨得我{i}更深{/i}，因为{i}我{/i}才是那个一直背负着愧疚、觉得自己夺走了我们本可以拥有的特别之物的人。

lines.en: : It’s not like I would have been loyal to you anyway. Which you probably knew back then. And {i}definitely{/i} know now. So calling it something that could have been special-
lines.zh: : 反正我也不见得会对你忠诚。这点你当时大概就知道。而现在{i}肯定{/i}更清楚。所以把它说成「本可以拥有的特别之物」——

lines.en: : You don’t know if that’s the truth, Sensei.  You can’t.
lines.zh: : 你不晓得那是不是事实，Sensei。你不可能知道。

lines.en: : Like {i}yes,{/i} I’d have wanted loyalty. {i}Yes,{/i} I’d want you all for myself. But you can’t just assume that you’d make a mistake like that.
lines.zh: : 就{i}好比，{/i}我当然想要忠诚。{i}当然{/i}想独占你。但你不能就这么假定自己一定会犯那样的错。

lines.en: : Like, it’s totally 100%% possible that we’d be a happy, monogamous couple to this day if I just kept focusing on you instead.
lines.zh: : 说实话，要是我当时一直把心思放在你身上，我们到今天完全有 100%% 的可能是一对幸福的一夫一妻。

lines.en: : If you want to call that a mistake, fine. If you want to call it a {i}regret{/i} even, fine!
lines.zh: : 你要说那是错误，行。你要说那是{i}遗憾{/i}，也行！

lines.en: : But to say I {i}forgot{/i} about you ignores the fact that it hurt {i}me{/i} too. A lot. And that you will {i}always{/i} be my first kiss.
lines.zh: : 可说我{i}忘了{/i}你，就是无视了它也伤了{i}我{/i}这件事。伤得很深。而且你{i}永远{/i}都是我的初吻对象。

lines.en: : Now, be my latest too.
lines.zh: : 那么，现在也做我最近的那一个吧。

lines.en: else:
scene rincafehairwoah37
: It’s {i}too{/i} much. Too good to be true, even. I haven’t earned it. I don’t deserve it. Nothing about this is fair to you.
lines.zh: : 这{i}太{/i}过了。甚至好得不像真的。我没有挣来它。我不配。这一切对你一点都不公平。

lines.en: : And if we kiss here, or do anything else for that matter, all it’ll do is resign you to the same life everyone around you is suffering from.
lines.zh: : 而要是我们在这儿接吻，或者做点别的什么，那只会让你同样认命地过上你身边所有人都在受苦的那种生活。

lines.en: : So you {i}are{/i} letting me down gently then?
lines.zh: : 那你是{i}真的{/i}要温柔地让我失望了？

lines.en: : I...don’t know what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道自己在做什么。

lines.en: : But you’re scared...aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你在害怕……对吧？

lines.en: : ...yeah.
: I think I might be.
lines.zh: : 我想我大概是。

lines.en: : It’s okay if you are. If you were to put your hand on my chest, I’m sure you’d feel it beating a thousand miles an hour right now.
lines.zh: : 害怕也没关系。要是你把手放在我胸口，我敢肯定你现在会感觉到它正以每小时一千英里的速度跳。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if you can measure a heartbeat in distance.
lines.zh: : 我不确定心跳能不能用距离来量。

lines.en: : Well, you’d change your mind if you felt mine. Regardless, this is what I want. {i}You{/i} are what I want.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你要是摸到我的，就会改主意了。不管怎样，这就是我想要的。{i}你{/i}就是我想要的。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah38
: Though, I...{i}should{/i} probably give you the...{i}slight{/i} disclaimer that I, once again, think it would be best if we held off on it leading to...other stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 不过，我……{i}应该{/i}得先给你一个……{i}小小的{/i}说明：我还是觉得，我们目前最好先别让它发展到……别的事情上去。

lines.en: : I still...want to try and take it slow. You can call it grooming if you want.
lines.zh: : 我还是……想试着慢慢来。你想叫它诱导也行。

lines.en: : I just think it’ll make for fonder memories if we can look back on this one day and realize how naturally we evolved. From friends to lovers.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，要是有一天我们回望此刻，发现自己演变得多自然——从朋友变成恋人——那会留下更温柔的回忆。

lines.en: : Can you actually love me, Rin? Like {i}really{/i} love me? As more than a confidant or homie or teacher or {i}anything{/i} like that?
lines.zh: : 你真的能爱我吗，Rin？就是{i}真正地{/i}爱我？不只是把我当知己、哥们、老师或者{i}任何{/i}那一类的？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah39
: Don’t you want to find that out together?
lines.zh: : 你不想我们一起找出答案吗？

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah40
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah41
: If you leave me for the next pretty girl who catches your eye, I will harvest {i}your{/i} skull and put it on display in my room.
lines.zh: : 要是你为了下一个入你眼的漂亮姑娘而离开我，我就把{i}你{/i}的头骨挖出来，摆在我房间里展览。

lines.en: : That’s the single most romantic thing anyone has ever said to me.
lines.zh: : 这是有史以来有人对我说过的最浪漫的一句话。

lines.en: scene rincafehairwoah42
Again, I find myself melting — this time with someone else.
lines.zh: 我又一次融化了——这一次是和另一个人。

lines.en: But there is no ledge for my existence to slowly drip from this time, so Rin just has to absorb me.
lines.zh: 不过这一次，没有供我一点点滴落的悬崖边缘，所以 Rin 只能把我吸收进去。

lines.en: And I think that, in a sense, she probably already has. And that the reason she’s so comfortable being with me is because a piece of me has already taken root in her.
lines.zh: 而我想，从某种意义上说，她大概已经做到了。而她跟我在一起之所以这么自在，是因为我的一部分早已在她体内生根。

lines.en: I just hope it’s a big enough piece that she’s been able to build up an immunity to all of the harm she’ll incur by giving herself to me.
lines.zh: 我只希望那一块够大，大到她已经能对把自己交给我所带来的所有伤害产生免疫力。

lines.en: I don’t want to think about that right now, though.
lines.zh: 不过我现在不想去想那个。

lines.en: I just want to sit here and do nothing. The same as her. In a place where we can just be ourselves.
lines.zh: 我只想坐在这儿，什么都不做。跟她一样。在一个我们都能只做自己的地方。

lines.en: Which means-
lines.zh: 也就是说——

lines.en: And I’m sorry to say this-
lines.zh: 而我很抱歉要说这句——
